title: Chaya Holay Holay Pak Ali Dheeyaan Da Naam Musallay Tay
body:
Koy Aaiy Jay Rang Wich Zarab Lagee (x2) Yaad Aa Gayi Shaam Musallay Tay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Baabay Ku Aain Namaaz Samajh Dheeyaan Masroof Hun Tashhud Wich
Kaad Qutila Da Aaiylaan Theeya
Much Gaaiy Kuhraam Musallay Tay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Chehray Tay Phool Jo Chunan Laga Sajaad Jay Safaar Ju Deed Gaee
Lagay Aawan Shoar Zanjeeraa Day
Koy Naeee Araam Musallay Tay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Saday Dhalay Hoaiy Bakht Da Wasta E Zakhmee Baba Ghaar Jaldi Ah
Ghayoor Imam Ku Dheeyaan Nay
Milay Aaan Salaam Musallay Tay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Chum Kadam Ali Jay Baba Day Roo Kay Abbas Sawal Kita
Kufay Day Sadar Bazaar Da Kayoon
Payaa Chainda Aay Naam Musallay Tay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Eek Roaza Qatal Nahee Hoya Naee Sirf Namaaz Shaheed Thaee
Paya Khoon Day Wich Saar Disdha Ha
Sara Islam Musallay Tay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shah Wal Wal Aakhaya Putraa Ku Ghaar Wanjan Da Jaldi Raha Bolo
Maida Dl Gabranda Ay Logaa Wich
Hay Balwa Aaam Musallay Tay.
